title: The Complete Adventures of Feluda
subtitle: Clever Crimes, Exotic Locales, Unforgettable Sleuthing
summary: Step into the vibrant world of Feluda, Satyajit Ray’s masterfully crafted detective, whose sharp intellect and keen observational skills unravel the knottiest mysteries across India and beyond. Accompanied by his wide-eyed cousin Topshe and the ever-entertaining Jatayu, Feluda dives into cases filled with cryptic clues, threatening letters, and sinister secrets lurking beneath everyday life. From the misty hills of Darjeeling to the bustling lanes of Calcutta, each story is a vivid journey, rich with wit, local color, and suspense. Whether you’re a fan of cerebral puzzles or thrilling adventures, these tales offer a captivating blend of humor, atmosphere, and intrigue that make Feluda an enduring icon of detective fiction.
